title: Physics: Benchmarking Foundation Models on University-Level Physics Problem Solving
abstract: arXiv:2503.21821v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Physics, a benchmark for evaluating foundation models on advanced physics problem solving. It contains 1034 annotated, open-ended problems from PhD-qualifying exams across six core physics domains. Solving these problems requires applying domain-specific knowledge to physical setups and carrying out multi-step mathematical reasoning. Each problem includes a worked solution and independently checked reference answers. An LLM-based grading protocol evaluates individual answers and complete multi-part problems, supporting numeric, symbolic, and text responses. We evaluate 53 proprietary and open-weight models. On test problems without figures, high accuracy is concentrated in a small group of thinking models, with the strongest open-weight models approaching proprietary performance. translated_title: Physics：基础模型在大学水平物理问题求解上的基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Physics，一个用于评估基础模型在高级物理问题求解能力的基准测试。它包含1034道来自六个核心物理领域博士资格考试的带标注开放式问题。解决这些问题需要将特定领域的知识应用于物理情境，并进行多步数学推理。每个问题都包含一个详细解答和经过独立核对的参考答案。基于LLM的评分协议可以评估单个答案和完整的多部分问题，支持数值、符号和文本形式的回答。我们评估了53个专有模型和开放权重模型。在没有图形的测试问题上，高准确率集中在少数推理模型（thinking models）中，其中最强的开放权重模型已接近专有模型的性能。大多数开放权重模型仍然只能解决不到一半的问题。我们对Qwen3.5-9B的分析揭示了其在应用物理知识方面的失败。
tldr: 提出了包含1034道博士资格考试物理题、配备LLM评分协议的基准测试Physics，对53个基础模型的评估表明仅少数推理模型能达到高准确率，而大多数开放权重模型解题率不足一半。
en_tdlr: Introduces Physics, a benchmark of 1034 annotated PhD-qualifying-exam physics problems with an LLM-based grading protocol, whose evaluation of 53 foundation models shows that only a small group of thinking models achieves high accuracy while most open-weight models solve fewer than half of the problems.
